title: Bounded Repair + Same-Session Retry

acceptance_gates.gate_1_retry_count_is_bounded: VERIFIED (Exceeding max_retries halts execution and raises RepairBudgetExhaustedError)
acceptance_gates.gate_2_same_session_context_identity_pre: VERIFIED (session_id, run_id, state_id, agent_id, and input_context_sha256 are strictly preserved across in-session attempts)
acceptance_gates.gate_3_non_retryable_failures_fail_immed: VERIFIED (Constitutional/Authority Lane/Security violations immediately raise NonRetryableFailureError without consuming retry budget)
acceptance_gates.gate_4_every_repair_is_observable: VERIFIED (Every repair attempt records an immutable RepairAttemptRecord with SHA-256 hash and failure diagnostics)
acceptance_gates.gate_5_exhaustion_enters_explicit_failur: VERIFIED (Budget exhaustion transitions terminal_state to FAILED_EXHAUSTED per StateM checked transfer semantics)

false_proof_defenses.defense_1_feed_same_failed_output_foreve: BLOCKED (Engine strictly halts after max_retries and transitions to FAILED_EXHAUSTED)
false_proof_defenses.defense_2_alter_output_contract_between_: BLOCKED (Altering contract ID during retry raises RepairContractDriftError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_3_retry_constitutional_violation: BLOCKED (Authority Lane violations halt immediately with NonRetryableFailureError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_4_reset_attempt_count: BLOCKED (Monotonic attempt counter prevents resetting attempt counts)

concrete_trace_demonstrated.pipeline_path: Attempt 1 Failure (Ungrounded Evidence) -> Corrective Feedback -> Attempt 2 In-Session Retry -> Gate Pass -> TypedAgentResult

limitations: Standalone Agent Session Runtime execution boundary will be formalized in Mandate M56
